text:
kyle: Heads up — spotted a broken anchor in the runtime guide, looks like 'kv-cache best practices' points to /guides/old-kv which 302s and then 404s. Seen in prod docs and in a customer repro.

maria: Which file / line? I can patch quickly if it's a single link.

kyle: /docs/runtime/perf.md around line 245. Grep output: 
```
$ sed -n '240,250p' docs/runtime/perf.md
... see section 'Caching and KV'
[...](../../guides/old-kv#best-practices)
```

docs-bot: :warning: link-scan: Dead anchor detected in /docs/runtime/perf.md (severity: medium)

eva: I can take a stab at a tiny PR. Do we want to update the link to /docs/runtime/kv-cache.md#best-practices or create a frontmatter redirect for the old shortlink?

maria: Prefer updating the link and adding a short redirect in frontmatter for the canonical old path so older shortlinks keep working.

tony: Agreed. Small note: if you add a redirect, use the canonical-redirect frontmatter key we standardized last quarter — example: 
```yaml
---
redirect_from:
  - /guides/old-kv
---
```
This avoids Search bounce.

eva: Cool. I'll make a quick branch. Plan: replace the inline link, add frontmatter redirect to the target doc, and add a test in link-check CI. Will ping for review.

kyle: Thanks. Also, while you're in there, there are two other shortlinks in the same file that look stale (search/kv-cache-tips, and /guides/legacy-cache). Quick grep: 
```
$ grep -n "guides/" -n docs/runtime/perf.md
162: [cache tuning](../../guides/legacy-cache)
245: [KV best practices](../../guides/old-kv#best-practices)
278: [search tips](../../guides/search/kv-cache-tips)
```

maria: @eva if you want me to co-author the PR I can tidy all three links and run the local link-checker before opening. I'm around this afternoon.

eva: That'd be great — assigning to you as owner for follow-up. I'll push an initial commit so you can pick it up.

docs-bot: PR opened by eva: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4987 — title: "fix: replace stale shortlinks in runtime/perf.md + redirects"

kyle: pinging @jamie for review once it's ready — especially for the redirect frontmatter snippet. Jamie, you're the last owner on the redirect schema.

jamie: Out today but back tomorrow morning, will review ASAP.

maria: Quick note for the PR: include a tiny test addition in docs/link-check to assert the old shortlink resolves (helps catch regressions). Suggested snippet in the test harness: 
```python
def test_old_kv_redirect(client):
    r = client.get('/guides/old-kv')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    assert b'KV cache' in r.data
```

eva: Thanks, adding that to the branch. Expect PR ready for review in ~30m.

kyle: Thanks all. After merge can someone also drop a quick note in the Release Notes channel if the redirect touches customer-facing shortlinks? Small FYI is fine.

maria: I'll follow up once merged.

docs-bot: PR #4987 merged by maria (1840000045) — change log: updated three links, added redirect frontmatter, extended link-check test.

eva: Nice — closing the loop. :tada:

kyle: Awesome, thanks — that should stop the 404 reports from support.

jamie: Reviewed post-merge, LGTM. One tiny nit I pushed as a follow-up PR to normalize the redirect key order. No impact.

maria: Archived thread; ping me if anything else pops up from the link-scan.

(automated) docs-bot: weekly-scan: all link-scan alerts for docs/runtime/perf.md resolved.
